sourcePolicies: Business-owner-confirmed lineage: TSETMC -> Novaran Amin -> Novaran API -> Financial Copilot Companies. ProviderName distinguishes source namespaces and ExternalCompanyId is scoped to that provider. Do not join companies to TSETMC instruments by ticker/name; use only the explicit optional NormalizedCompanyId mapping and retain unresolved or ambiguous state.

Filter provider and accepted logical revision. NoavaranCurrentApi monthly actuals use ProductSales/OutputType=0 for the governed single-month source; service route is distinct. CyclicalWaves is a separate provider and must not be merged by external ID alone.
Industry is source classification; do not infer SIC-like cross-provider categories.
Keep provider provenance for external identifiers.
No direct FK from IndustryGroups to Industries is present.

Product-owner-confirmed historical lineage: TSETMC -> direct TSETMC ingestion / historical migration -> Financial Copilot TradingInstruments. Current code also registers TsetmcDirectFeedSyncService; TsetmcPollingWorker schedules instrument sync at end of day when its worker flag and adapter operational settings are enabled. StockMarketDbSyncService currently reads its instrument dataset but deliberately does not write TradingInstruments. ProviderName must be retained.
Respect SourceProviderName, output-type fields, data completeness, and existing specialized response policy.
Use accepted header with the matching provider, report type and output type. Never merge products by title across companies/providers.

Dates and identifiers; no monetary measure in header.
Identifiers and labels, not financial measures. Market values and prices are stored on linked observations; their numeric PostgreSQL types do not encode display unit or scaling.
Identifiers and labels; no financial units.

Mutable reference state; the current TSETMC adapter sets SourceChangedAt and LastSynchronizedAt to the synchronization timestamp, not a vendor change timestamp. Scheduled refresh is end-of-day when worker and adapter settings enable it; these fields do not prove every instrument was refreshed. Market snapshots carry their own exchange date/time and source receipt/observation time.
Normalized closed report period; VendorPeriodDate retains vendor period date when available.
Period comes from parent MonthlyReports; output type 0 represents single-month actuals in the governed Noavaran path.
Persisted SalesAmount is million IRR; product quantities retain provider units; response layer converts amount to billion toman (value × 0.0001) where that contract applies. Mixed units are flagged.

Quantity uses the row’s Unit. SalesAmount is in million IRR per the owner-supplied definition and trend persistence contract. The line-level SalesRate is a stored source/provider value where present; its implied unit is million IRR per source quantity unit. The separate governed MonthlyAverageSalesRate snapshot is total monthly SalesAmount divided by total SalesQuantity for selected product rows, only when units are not mixed and total quantity is nonzero. It is null when no usable quantity exists. Preserve negative source values; do not substitute the snapshot formula for a source-line SalesRate.
ReportYear/ReportMonth are report month; calendar/fiscal fields are separate. CalculatedAtUtc is not report period end.
ReportingType is an integer code; other identifiers are keys, not measures.
